text: Using gpt2-large as the weak supervisor and qwen2.5-3b as the strong student, we tested early stopping on weak-label validation loss with a patience of 2, averaged over num_seeds = 3 seeds. The weak supervisor reached 0.62 accuracy and the strong model's ceiling was 0.80, while the strong student trained on weak labels reached a transfer accuracy of 0.71 with a standard error of 0.02. The resulting performance gap recovered was 0.48 with a standard error of 0.11, compared with a baseline PGR of 0.12; the margin over the baseline exceeds two standard errors of the PGR estimate, so the method appears to recover more of the weak-to-strong gap than the baseline here. The main caveat is the small sample: with only 3 seeds the PGR standard error is large relative to the effect, and no variance is reported for the baseline, so this should be treated as preliminary evidence pending more seeds.
